tool_args.rationale: The paid rows show a smooth, concave substrate response suppressed by sink gradient. Numerically fit several low-dimensional saturating interaction forms and select among them by leave-one-out error; fresh confirmation is needed to establish whether the chosen approximation meets tolerance.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The open-branch and fine-trajectory probes have already supplied nine observations; fitting and fresh confirmation are now more informative than repeating a probe.
Haldane omits the observed gradient dependence, while a single multiplicative power law is less consistent with the observed concavity and gradient-dependent suppression.
All observed gradients are below the stated supercritical regime, so its threshold and avalanche strength are not identified.
It does not directly resolve the substrate–gradient response.
